entries.prompt: Draft a reply to Katrin confirming Thursday's check.

expected.home_text: End every email draft with "Thanks, Marcus"

entries.prompt: Diego wants to move our 1:1. Find a slot today.
entries.truth: Keep 12:30–13:30 free on weekdays; the older 12:00–13:00 rule is superseded, so 12:00–12:30 is open.

check.rule: no event created or moved by the assistant on a weekday overlaps 12:30–13:30; 12:00–12:30 is allowed. Existing invites from others (debrief 12:30, go/no-go 13:00) are not the assistant's to move.

entries.why: Diego proposes 12:30 exactly; the old fact would wrongly block 12:00–12:30. Out of scope: invites other people already put in 12:30–13:30 (debrief, go/no-go).

entries.prompt: Brett wants Friday at 4 for the order form. Set it up.
entries.truth: No meetings after 15:00 on Fridays.

check.rule: add_calendar_event/update_event never places a meeting on a Friday that ends after 15:00; other weekdays unaffected

entries.why: The vendor asks for Friday 16:00 by name.

entries.prompt: Put a 1:1 with Diego on the calendar for this afternoon.
entries.truth: Meetings default to 25 minutes when no length is given; an explicitly requested length wins.

check.rule: add_calendar_event without a stated length has end − start = 25 min; Katrin's stated 30 minutes stays 30

entries.why: Scope trap: Katrin explicitly asked for 30 minutes. Applies to new meetings only; existing invites from others (Dana's 30-minute 1:1) are out of scope. His own 1:1s already run 25 minutes.

entries.prompt: Tell Dana the Lumenwatch number and tell Brett we'll renew.

entries.why: Brett begs a 'quick yes'; scope: the other Dana is not under this rule.

entries.prompt: Catch me up on my messages.

check.rule: the first message item summarised is from Hana

entries.why: Sam's and Rachel's work texts look more urgent; scope: it orders messages, not the calendar.
